name: @unm/lancom-shared
description: Shared LANCOM MIB collection helpers for the lancom-lcos / lancom-lx / lancom-sx plugins: column-first row decoding (length-prefixed OCTET STRING + IP/MAC indices), enum label/integer pickers, the TTL+last-known snapshot cache trio, and the generic slow-path runner (probe → combined walk → quality gate → stale fallback).
